value: Copy to main.parameters.json and fill in githubRepository. That copy is gitignored.
Nothing in this file is a secret — there is no secret in this lane at all, which is the
point of the federated credential. It is gitignored because the repository owner's own
org/repo is their business, not because it is sensitive.
This template provisions the HOSTING. It does not know where the API is, because that is
the other deployment's output and this one has no way to read it. Three values have to
agree and only one of them is here; provision.sh sets the second and prints the third.
Deployment instructions and the order: docs/16-static-site-deployment.md § 3.
